text_nodes.text: On October 1, 2026, the Frontera queues will be closed permanently.
The Texas Advanced Computing Center put a warning at the top of Frontera's user guide. The guide was last updated September 3rd, 2026.
Seven years, and one last edit.
"After seven years and billions of computing cycles, Frontera will be riding off into decommission sunset."
Frontera is the largest cluster dedicated to open science in the United States
FRONTERA USER GUIDE ONE PROMISE FOR AFTER THE DATE
The cable goes somewhere the page does not.
The guide says the file systems stay reachable to move data off. It names no machine the work goes to.
The money is real. The manual is not finished.

A construction award with a start date and an end date. What it does not yet have is a finished guide.
